title: Microsoft Word: Edit Documents
summary: Craft your story with formatting and grammar tools to ensure it’s right, always
description:
Create, edit, read and share documents on your mobile device with the same power and familiarity you rely on from your PC.

Write CVs, letters, assignments, notes or creative work on the go. Convert between Word and PDF, collaborate with others and access your files from anywhere. With easy to use editing tools and a built in document viewer, Word makes mobile writing simple and efficient.

Choose from templates for CVs, newsletters, brochures and more to jump start any project. Whether you're a student, blogger, journalist or project manager, Word moves with you.

Create Documents

• Get started quickly with modern templates for letters, CVs, scripts, proposals, invoices and more
• Use rich formatting and layout tools to express your ideas clearly
• Keep your documents looking great on any device

Read, Write and Edit Anywhere

• Edit long documents with familiar writing and formatting tools
• Open attachments and view documents with the built in reader
• Convert PDFs to Word for easy editing

Collaborate and Share

• Comment alongside text to share feedback
• Work with others in real-time and track changes to text and layout
• Use version history to view or restore earlier drafts

Simplified Sharing

• Invite others to edit or view with a few taps
• Manage permissions and see who’s in the document
• Copy content into an email with formatting intact or attach your files directly

AI Assistance with Copilot*

• Draft CVs, polish proposals and organise ideas in seconds
• Summarise, refine and automatically format content
• Get intelligent suggestions that make your writing clear and impactful

Requirements

• 1 GB RAM or higher

*Unlock the full Microsoft 365 experience with a qualifying Microsoft 365 subscription for your phone, tablet, PC or Mac.

Microsoft 365 subscriptions purchased in app are billed to your Play Store account and renew automatically unless disabled in account settings. Subscriptions cannot be cancelled during the active period.

This app may be provided by Microsoft or a third party publisher and is subject to its own privacy statement and terms. Data may be transferred to or stored in the United States or other regions where Microsoft or its service providers operate.
